## Problem

Describe the reproduced problem and why it belongs in this project.

## Scoped change

List the affected skill contract, release tooling, or documentation. Confirm that unrelated architecture and behavior remain unchanged.

## Verification

List the exact checks that ran and their results. For skill behavior changes, identify focused evaluation cases and any compatibility impact.

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, private repository details, transcripts, logs, or generated backups are included.
- [ ] Existing four-skill ownership boundaries and proportional routing are preserved.
- [ ] Installer changes were tested in an isolated target and do not silently replace user configuration.
- [ ] Residual uncertainty and unsupported environments are disclosed.
